UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

normalizeProjectKey

Maps legacy/alternate project URL slugs to canonical data keys via PROJECT_ALIASES; unknown slugs pass through unchanged.

titled

Titled descriptor with the pipe-separated page suffix.

contactDescription

Contact-route meta description — "Contact | Mail, Phone, …" composed from the live components dictionary (loaded per locale before routes resolve, so this is correctly localized at parse time unlike the pages/* nodes, which views push post-fetch).

legalRoute

Legal-page descriptor — page label comes from the localized legal-links component text.

parsePath

Pure resolution: pathname → route descriptor { name, view, lang, path, meta, params }. meta.scrollTo triggers a post-nav smooth-scroll to that element id.
